title: fix(examples): fix missing polyfill in e-commerce demo
body:
**Summary**

Some IE11 compatibility issues on the e-commerce demo remains even after https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4049 due to some missing polyfills.

This PR adds the polyfill suggested in [the documentation](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/installation/js/#browser-support).
